user.title: Find your bin collection zone
user.description:
Enter your street address in the City of Frankston, e.g. `8 Robinsons Road, Frankston South`. Leave it blank to use your Home Assistant home location.

Collection zones come from the council's bin day finder at {lookup_url}.

pick.title: Choose your address
pick.description: More than one address matched. Pick yours:

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the address or collection zone service. Try again shortly.
error.address_not_found: No address matched. Try including the street type and suburb, e.g. `8 Robinsons Road, Frankston South`.
error.outside_frankston: That address isn't inside a Frankston City Council collection zone.

abort.already_configured: This address is already set up.

init.title: Collection day rollover
init.description: On collection day, after this time the integration stops showing today's collection and moves on to the next one.
